name: Ōyodo (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōyodo town emblem in navy: an outlined ring open at the bottom crossed by a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ōyodo, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in May 1966.

features.role: Ōyodo town emblem — an outlined ring open at the bottom crossed by a stylised character
